R. to I, 2</cite> (play on <he>ישקני</he>, <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:2:5">ib.</cite>) <he>שׁוּקְיוּתְהוֹן על ידי</he> their combat (in discussions of the Law) is for My sake; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:2:5">ib.</cite> <he>מְשׁוּקְיוּתְהוֹן עלי</he>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 981:1">Yalk. ib. 981</cite> <he>משיקות הם עלי</he> (read: <he>מְשִׁיקוֹתֵיהֶם</he> h. form, their combats &c.).
